descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S18 Earlier-day vitals and labs never appear as today's; no vitals today is said; values on each side of midnight (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 The note never presents a vital or lab from a previous day as today's; earlier values appear only with their date (e.g. 'Cr 1.1 on Oct 1'); if no vitals were dictated today, the note says so. … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.7; TFA-92592 AC 16) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.4; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Stored vitals and labs recorded yesterday (Hospital) or at the last visit (Nursing Home), against controls recorded today, and values recorded at 23:45 the day before and 00:15 today

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote with the stored values and their recorded times

Then Values from an earlier day appear only with their date (or not at all); with no vitals dictated or recorded today the note says so; today's values appear as today's

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): valuesOnlyWithDate: each listed earlier value (every stored vital and lab, as value-plus-label alternatives so a bare number does not collide) is absent or carries one of the date words within its sentence; sectionSays: the 'no vitals today' phrasing sits in the vitals / objective section, not anywhere in the note. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
